recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. If similar rendering is found in the external Admin Incubator operation page, handle that in the external IG rather than by changing this core checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-15609 asked to correct literal /n/n-style newline characters throughout STU3 Patient operations section 8.1.18.1, apparently by breaking the text into separate paragraphs.
initial_application: Jira records the issue as auto-approved and later marked applied, with the editor stating no direct change was made because the then-current build was already fixed. No repository commit explicitly mentions FHIR-15609. A pre-removal inspection of Patient $everything source showed paragraph-separating XML character references rather than the reported literal /n/n text.
additional_context: Patient remains an active core resource, but current source/patient/list-Patient-operations.xml lists only Patient-match and Patient-purge. Commit b487fdda4bb4a5382a93dbb5a811efd02425b9bc removed the Patient $everything OperationDefinition from core, and current source/http.html links Patient $everything to the Admin Incubator IG. Negative current-source and community searches found no evidence that FHIR core still carries the reported typo.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because current in-scope FHIR core source does not contain the reported /n/n or backslash-n typo in the relevant Patient operations material.
